dslRule:
<!id: stringfieldeditor.unlimited.width>
<!description: Replace magic number for StringFieldEditor width with the UNLIMITED constant for better maintainability and responsiveness.>
<!severity: INFO>
new org.eclipse.jface.preference.StringFieldEditor($key, $label, 45, $lines, org.eclipse.jface.preference.StringFieldEditor.VALIDATE_ON_FOCUS_LOST, $parent)
=>
new org.eclipse.jface.preference.StringFieldEditor($key, $label, org.eclipse.jface.preference.StringFieldEditor.UNLIMITED, $lines, org.eclipse.jface.preference.StringFieldEditor.VALIDATE_ON_FOCUS_LOST, $parent)
;;
summary: Replace the literal `45` with `StringFieldEditor.UNLIMITED` in `StringFieldEditor` constructor calls.
